newsitem.title: USA: Millicom to buy Russian telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: Millicom to buy Russian telecom stake.

text.p: Millicom International Cellular SA said on Tuesday it agreed to buy a 60.6 percent stake in St. Petersburg Telecom.
Millicom said it would buy the stake in the cellular company from Motorola Inc and Soyuzkontrakt. The terms were not disclosed.
Millicom would become the operator of St. Petersburg Telecom, making Millicom the majority owner and operator of cellular systems in 10 Russian cities covering 40 million people.
Company President Jay Metcalfe said that with this acquisition, "We consider that Millicom has an unrivaled position from which to become a major cellular operator in Russia."

Millicom develops and operates cellular telephone services around the world. In March it announced plans to spin off its Asian operations into a separate, publicly listed company. It also said it was considering partners or buyers for its Latin American operations.
